latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of warehouse-optimization: a comprehensive e-commerce warehouse and inventory optimization advisor.

- Analyzes inventory health and calculates safety stock and reorder points
- Performs ABC analysis and evaluates fulfillment and storage costs
- Supports all fulfillment models: Self-fulfillment, Amazon FBA/FBM, Walmart WFS, 3PL, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Dropshipping, and Hybrid setups
- Provides actionable recommendations for reducing stockouts, minimizing costs, and improving efficiency (including Amazon IPI optimization)
- No API key required; offers structured prompts and workflows for gathering user input and delivering guidance
